messages.subject: Follow-up | Strategic Value Creation Brief for Nokia
messages.body:
Dear Ms. EL-Khodary,

Following my earlier introduction, I prepared a concise strategic value brief focused on Nokia's AI-native network strategy, Saudi localization, critical-industry solutions and stakeholder priorities.

The paper addresses government and digital-policy alignment, local talent and technology development, AI and defense stakeholder governance, and evidence-based sustainability execution. These areas connect closely with my experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, regulatory coordination and strategic partnerships.

My executive CV is included in the final three pages. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding international leadership needs across government relations, external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, sustainability or related country-facing functions.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com
linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for Nokia
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Nokia is accelerating its AI-native network and automation strategy while expanding local research, critical-industry solutions and partnerships across strategic markets. Recent initiatives include a new Saudi research and development center focused on AI-powered network automation, deeper AI-RAN development and new edge capabilities for mining, construction, public safety and defense. These priorities place government relations, local talent, security, industrial policy and responsible technology deployment alongside commercial execution. My director-level experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and regulated stakeholder coordination would support Nokia by strengthening institutional alignment and turning external commitments into accountable cross-functional delivery.
strategic_brief.company_context: Nokia's September 2026 activity illustrates a broad shift toward AI-native networks and local-market capability. The company opened its first research and development center in Saudi Arabia to advance AI-powered network automation, develop local AI talent and support exportable technology aligned with Vision 2030. Nokia also announced AI-RAN developments with NVIDIA, expanded agentic network automation with Microsoft and launched an AI and edge platform aimed at mining, construction, public safety and defense organizations. These initiatives span highly regulated and strategic sectors where government policy, data and security expectations, workforce localization, industrial partnerships and public confidence materially affect market adoption. Strong stakeholder governance can help link technical innovation with national priorities and clear accountability.

opportunities.title: Government and digital-policy alignment
opportunities.rationale: AI-native networks, cloud automation and critical-industry connectivity operate within policy frameworks covering spectrum, cybersecurity, data, national infrastructure and industrial development. Structured institutional engagement can help Nokia connect product roadmaps with government priorities and anticipate regulatory dependencies before they affect market execution.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build country stakeholder maps linking ministries, regulators, investment agencies, public-sector customers and internal owners, supported by issue registers and escalation routes that connect policy engagement directly with business and delivery priorities.

opportunities.title: Saudi localization and talent strategy
opportunities.rationale: The new Saudi research center creates a visible commitment around local AI capability, skills development and exportable technology. Clear governance around talent, partnerships, investment and public commitments can strengthen alignment with Vision 2030 while providing measurable evidence of national economic value.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would structure local-value commitments around measurable talent, partnership and capability outcomes, with named owners and evidence across HR, research, government relations, sustainability and business teams to support credible institutional reporting.

opportunities.title: AI and critical-industry stakeholder governance
opportunities.rationale: Nokia's edge platform targets mining, construction, public safety and defense environments where resilience, safety, security and operating continuity matter alongside technology performance. Successful adoption requires coordination with regulators, operational leaders, security stakeholders and public institutions across complex user environments.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish stakeholder and commitment frameworks around regulated industry deployments, linking operational requirements, security expectations, sustainability outcomes and executive ownership so non-technical dependencies are managed alongside technical implementation.

opportunities.title: Responsible innovation evidence
opportunities.rationale: AI-driven automation and network intelligence increase expectations around security, energy efficiency, data governance and responsible deployment. Credible external positioning requires clear linkage between public claims and operating evidence across technology, legal, sustainability and corporate-affairs functions.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen evidence ownership and cross-functional review for material AI, sustainability and local-value commitments, drawing on practical experience with data traceability, environmental systems and executive stakeholder reporting in a regulated operating environment.

days_0_30: Map priority markets, institutions, AI policy dependencies and external commitments.
Review ownership of local-value, security and sustainability actions.
Identify stakeholder issues with direct market, adoption or reputation impact.
days_31_60: Align government, technology, business and sustainability engagement plans.
Create a consolidated issue and commitment register with named owners.
Define executive indicators for policy alignment, local talent and external risk.
days_61_90: Run focused engagement on priority AI, cybersecurity and industrial-policy issues.
Embed periodic cross-functional review of country risks and commitments.
Strengthen evidence controls for responsible innovation and local-value claims.
days_91_180: Scale the governance model across priority markets and critical-industry deployments.
Measure issue closure and commitment performance.
Codify lessons into a repeatable technology stakeholder playbook.

potential_impact: Stronger alignment between Nokia's AI strategy and government digital priorities.
More measurable local talent and technology outcomes in Saudi Arabia and other strategic markets.
Improved visibility across security, regulatory and stakeholder dependencies in critical industries.
More credible evidence behind responsible innovation and sustainability positioning.
background_relevance: Director-level responsibility across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational regulated environment.
Direct engagement with ministries, regulators, public institutions, communities and contractors around strategic projects and compliance matters.
Experience coordinating external expectations across operations, legal, finance, procurement, environment, HR and leadership teams.
Practical work on data traceability, local participation, environmental systems and stakeholder governance.
